To address the F5 E2 error on your WFW5620HW0, you should check the following:

1. Ensure that the door is closing completely and that there are no items blocking it, as this can prevent the door from locking properly [2][6].
2. Verify that the door lock system is functioning correctly. You may need to refer to TEST #4: Door Lock System in the service manual for detailed troubleshooting steps [2][3][5].

If these checks do not resolve the issue, further diagnostics may be necessary.

results.answer: To address the F3E2 error code on your WFW5620HW0, you should check the wash temperature sensor, as this fault indicates that the sensor is either out of range, or there is an open circuit or short circuit detected. Refer to TEST #10: Wash Temperature Sensor on page 3-17 of the service manual W11169652 Rev B for detailed troubleshooting steps [1].
